summary: Command dispatch helper: reads the global object pointer dword_7CD8C0, calls a __thiscall virtual method at byte offset 28 of the object's vtable with argument 27 to obtain an object pointer, and if that pointer is non-null passes it to StandingsDisplay. Always returns 0. Invoked by several UI/session paths to open the standings display.

operations.description: Fetch an object pointer through a __thiscall virtual method: dereference dword_7CD8C0 (0x007CD8C0) as a vtable pointer and call the method at byte offset 28 (argument slot 27).
Guard on the returned object pointer v0: only when non-null is StandingsDisplay invoked.
Call StandingsDisplay (0x0046A560) with the non-null object pointer v0.
Always return 0, whether or not the object was displayed.
Called by ProfileAlreadyExistsPageHandler (0x0046CB50), sub_485B90 (0x00485B90) and SystemOSAPICall (0x004A03F0) to trigger the standings display path.

unresolved: Identity of the global object at dword_7CD8C0 and the meaning of argument 27 / vtable offset 28 are unknown here.
Object contract of StandingsDisplay's argument is unknown.
